summary: Practise cash-flow analysis, Excel scenario modelling and finance decision reporting. Explore the five-day course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Advanced financial management helps finance professionals turn financial data and assumptions into decision-ready recommendations. Finance analysts, treasury officers and managers practise analysing cash flows and earnings, testing forecast scenarios in Excel, and comparing capital requests using NPV and WACC. They also map financing exposures and prepare concise recommendations that explain key assumptions, risks and sensitivities for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who contribute to forecasts, funding reviews, performance explanations or investment recommendations and want a structured foundation in advanced financial decision support.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with financial statements, budgets or finance reports will help you follow the case exercises. No coding or programming is required. Advanced valuation and financial risk topics receive operational application rather than technical implementation depth.
